title: Send licence keys and download links
problem: Mark as sent on a digital order sent nothing and the key was not shown anywhere.
now: Sending gives each licence its key and each download its link, messages the customer, and shows them with Resend.
steps: Create an approved order for the security licence (no delivery charge is added)
Open it and press Mark as sent
Press Show to see the key, then Resend
notes: Where: Order page of a digital order (Send the download or key card, then Download and keys)
